lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in a repetitive, roughly rectangular grid pattern across the mid-flank; blobs are distributed in at least four distinct horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like anchor system in the central-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal side) to shadow (ventral side).

other_distinctive_markers: A high-contrast elongated biological feature (remora) is attached horizontally across the central surface of the pectoral fin.
